narrative:
The consolidated FY2026 plan delivers gross profit of NOK 1,690M (+8.2%) and adjusted EBITDA of NOK 680M (40.2% of GP) across 21 markets. GP per message rises to 6.8 øre on 24.9bn messages.

The bridge from FY2025 is: traffic growth +68, price pass-through +55, conversational mix +62 and route savings +38, partly offset by operator price increases −60 and wholesale decline −35. The plan sits 1.7% below the double-digit ambition — inside the 5% finance-gate tolerance, and closable if the pending agent levers from earlier phases are accepted.

The Board & IR pack is generated from the same governed numbers in Snowflake. Every figure traces back to its market, product and route.
